StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack (powers.py:64-66) adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterSideTurnEnd.issue: NARROWED 2026-07-27. THE SLOT HALF IS CLOSED: the player leg is now `after_player_turn_end` (powers.py:1531), which combat.py:809 fires after the turn-end card effects and the hand flush -- Hook.AfterTurnEnd (CombatManager.cs:1307). WHAT REMAINS, both re-verified in today's code: (1) the sim OMITS the dealer. ConstrictPower.cs:23 is `CreatureCmd.Damage(ctx, Owner, Amount, ValueProp.Unpowered, base.Owner, null)`; powers.py:1527-1529 calls `DamageCmd.deal(hooks, self.owner, self.amount, props=...)` leaving the `dealer` parameter (cmds.py:92) None, so `on_damage_dealt` (cmds.py:187-188) never fires for the squeeze -- dormant for the old reason, every ported reflect listener needs IsPoweredAttack and this damage is Unpowered. (2) the sim ADDS an `is_dead` guard to the enemy leg (powers.py:1536) that ConstrictPower.cs:21's `participants.Contains(base.Owner)` does not have; that matters more now, because a prevented death leaves the creature dead at 0 HP and retained in combat (cmds.py:51-64) rather than floored at 1 HP.

AfterDeath.issue: NARROWED 2026-07-27. THE ENGINE HALF IS CLOSED: `hooks.on_death` now carries `was_removal_prevented` and fires on BOTH arms of `_resolve_death` (hooks.py:799-811, cmds.py:49 and :63), mirroring CreatureCmd.cs:519 / :566. WHAT REMAINS is this power's own guard: ConstrictPower.cs:29 is `if (!wasRemovalPrevented && creature == base.Applier)` and powers.py:1539-1542 still tests only `creature is self.applier`, ignoring the argument it is now handed -- so a prevented death of the applier drops the power in the sim and keeps it in the game. Reachability has GROWN rather than shrunk: prevented deaths now really leave a retained creature at 0 HP.

guards.rationale: The sim's two legs self-filter to the owner instead (powers.py:1442, :1446). The per-creature-vs-per-side question does not arise: the enemy leg already uses the side-scoped slot.

powers.py:1438 passes DamageProps.NON_CARD_UNPOWERED, which is UNPOWERED alone (valueprops.py:42) and so is absorbed by block -- matching C# omitting Unblockable. Contrast power/demise, whose C# damage IS Unblockable and whose sim port correctly uses NON_CARD_HP_LOSS.
Neither side ticks Constrict; it damages for Amount every round until the applier dies. Both agree.
